inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Analyzing Malicious Microsoft Graph API Rate Limit Count

properties.description:
This detection identifies malicious or suspicious Microsoft Graph API activity originating from known attacker infrastructure (proxy IPs) by analyzing Graph API rate limit counts over a 90-day period.

The query leverages Behavior Analytics logs to extract source IP addresses associated with threat intelligence indicators marked as “proxy.” It then cross-references these IPs against the Microsoft Graph Activity Logs to determine if any of them are responsible for a high volume of API calls that hit Microsoft Graph rate limits, which can be indicative of:

Enumeration activity (e.g., mailbox, users, or SharePoint enumeration)

Token replay or automation attempts

Bulk data exfiltration or reconnaissance

Use of compromised app registrations / OAuth abuse

By summarizing and ranking the RateLimitedCount by AppId, resource path, and HTTP method, this detection highlights suspicious Graph API clients and operations potentially abused by adversaries
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Analyzing Malicious Microsoft Graph API Rate Limit Count
properties.query:
let AttackerIPs =
BehaviorAnalytics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| extend ThreatIntelIndicatorDescription = tostring(DevicesInsights.ThreatIntelIndicatorDescription)
| where ThreatIntelIndicatorDescription contains "proxy"
| distinct SourceIPAddress;
MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs 
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d) 
| where IPAddress has_any(AttackerIPs)
| extend path = replace_string(replace_string(replace_regex(tostring(parse_url(RequestUri).Path), @'(\/)+','//'),'v1.0/',''),'beta/','') 
| extend UriSegments = extract_all(@'\/([A-z2]+|\$batch)($|\/|\(|\$)',dynamic([1]),tolower(path))
| extend OperationResource = strcat_array(UriSegments,'/')| summarize RateLimitedCount=count() by AppId, OperationResource, RequestMethod 
| sort by RateLimitedCount desc
